headline: Last session: Sense sense plunged nearly 900 points as banking and IT stocks led a sharp market sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: The Indian stock market is closed today, October 20, 2026, in observance of the Dussehra holiday.
On the last trading day, the Sensex crashed over 876 points, wiping out Rs 5 lakh crore in investor wealth.
Heavy selling in the banking and IT sectors drove the Nifty50 below the 22,900 level on Monday.
Market sentiment was dampened by global cues and sectoral weaknesses ahead of the mid-week break.
whatHappening: Paras Healthcare raised Rs 652.50 crore from anchor investors ahead of its IPO opening on October 21.
EAAA India Alternatives announced a Rs 1,200 crore IPO via an Offer for Sale starting October 26.
The India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement (FTA) officially came into force today.
Normal trading operations on the NSE and BSE are scheduled to resume on Wednesday, October 21.
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Dussehra following a sharp sell-off on Monday that saw the Sensex plunge nearly 900 points. The crash, driven by losses in banking and IT sectors, wiped out Rs 5 lakh crore of investor wealth. Meanwhile, the primary market remains active with Paras Healthcare and EAAA India Alternatives announcing key IPO milestones.
